raw:
The user wants UI strings for a player app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). A recorded video content fails to play due to unsupported file format.

- s1: error message (one sentence) - something like "此檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" or "無法播放此檔案，格式不支援。"
- s2: button on the error screen - could be "確定" or "返回" or "瞭解" - Taiwan UI often uses "確定" or "好". Maybe "返回" makes sense. Let me think: on an error screen, typical button would be "確定" or "關閉". Perhaps "返回" to go back. I'll go with "確定" or "返回". Common Taiwan style: "確定".

Actually for an error page with a single button, "確定" is typical. Could also be "知道了" (more mainland/Taiwan both used). Taiwan usage: "好" or "確定". I'll use "確定".

- s3: the name of this feature area at the top of the screen - like the page title. Something like "播放" or "影片播放" or "媒體播放器". The top navigation bar title. Since it's a player app and user opens recorded video content, the top area could be "播放器" or "影片播放". I'll use "播放器" or "播放頁面". Hmm, "功能區名稱" - the feature section name at top. Could be "播放". I'll go with "播放器".

Taiwan terminology check: 檔案 (not 文件), 格式, 支援, 影片 (not 视频), 視訊? 影片 is standard Taiwan. "不支援的檔案格式" fine.

s1: "此影片的檔案格式不支援，無法播放。" — one sentence.

Use Traditional Chinese with Taiwan style. 瞭解/了解 — Taiwan prefers 瞭解. But I'm using 確定 for s2.

JSON only output.</think>{"s1": "此影片的檔案格式不支援，無法播放。", "s2": "確定", "s3": "播放器"}

parsed.s1: 此影片的檔案格式不支援，無法播放。
